resources.string_add: No database server answered at this host.
The database server refused this user and password.
This user has no database with this name it may use.
Check the host, and the port or socket if you set one.
Nothing answers here. Use the MySQL host your hosting panel shows, often localhost; with Docker, the database service's name, such as mysql.
Check the user name, and that this user may connect from this web server.
Check the password of this user.
Create an empty database with this name first, or enter the name of one you have created.
Check the name. If the database exists, give this user all privileges on it in your hosting panel; if not, create it first, empty.
